project_note: The owner's UE 5.6 fixture project (2026-11-10): created once by tools/consumers/unreal.py ensure_project and reused; its Saved, Intermediate and DerivedDataCache (project graph UzFixtureDDC, Zen not launched) live there.
import_method: UnrealEditor-Cmd.exe <project> -run=pythonscript -script=tools/consumers/unreal_ue.py -nullrhi -unattended (Python Editor Script Plugin commandlet); each file through unreal.AssetImportTask (automated) and AssetTools.import_asset_tasks
delivery_adapter: generation-pinning (08-export.md section 5): current.json read once, receipt and every file verified by size and SHA-256, only the verified bytes staged into <project>/Import/<fixture>/<variant>/<generation>/ and verified again; no fixed-name directory is read

expected_bindings.BaseColor: sRGB (PNG/TGA TC_Default, DDS TC_BC7), sampler Color, RGB to Base Color
expected_bindings.OcclusionRoughnessMetallic: linear (PNG/TGA TC_Masks, DDS TC_BC7), sampler Masks or Linear Color, R to Ambient Occlusion, G to Roughness, B to Metallic
expected_bindings.Normal: TC_Normalmap (linear), green not flipped (DirectX), sampler Normal, RGB to Normal
expected_bindings.Emissive: sRGB, sampler Color, RGB to Emissive Color; absent when the receipt lists it skipped
expected_bindings.SpecularWeight: no binding: the receipt's consumer gap

blocked_by: UE 5.6 imports no BC5 or BC7 DDS: the DDS variant (item 3.3) is refused at import

observations.run: 2026-11-10, tests/parity/tier1/test_unreal_consumer_pilots.py (3 passed, 2158.8 s) and tests/export/test_unreal_consumer.py (17 passed); UE 5.6.1 changelist 44394996
observations.png16_pilots: Wand v1, Sash v5 and Tunic v10 production PNG 16 exports (the item 3.1 rebuilds, equal to Painter under EXC-013 and EXC-014 in the same run) import through the pinning adapter; every binding holds and UE's exported source equals each published file in decoded values at 16 bits
observations.tga8_wand: Wand v1 TGA 8 (same project, dithering off) imports with the same bindings; UE's source equals each file at 8 bits
observations.as_imported_defaults: UE's default importer (Interchange) sets BaseColor, ORM and Emissive sRGB with TC_Default and detects the Normal as TC_Normalmap (linear, TEXTUREGROUP_WorldNormalMap, green not flipped); the consumer must clear sRGB on the ORM and set TC_Masks, which the fixture does
observations.material: One material binds BaseColor RGB (sampler Color), ORM R/G/B to Ambient Occlusion/Roughness/Metallic (sampler Masks) and Normal RGB (sampler Normal); the Windows cook compiles it with 0 errors and 0 warnings
observations.cooked_formats: Windows cook of the Wand v1 PNG 16 and TGA 8 textures: BaseColor PF_DXT1, ORM PF_DXT1, Normal PF_BC5
observations.dds: UE 5.6 imports none of the DDS variant's files: Interchange imports nothing without a message and the legacy TextureFactory reports 'DDS DXGIFormat not supported' for BC5_UNORM (83), BC7_UNORM (98) and BC7_UNORM_SRGB (99); a probe also shows BC1 and BC3 (DX10 and DX9 FourCC DXT1, DXT5, ATI2, BC5U) refused and uncompressed R8G8B8A8 and R16G16B16A16 DDS imported
observations.cook_gap: No BC data passes into UE 5.6: it imports only uncompressed sources and encodes the platform format itself on cook, so the DDS cannot pass through the cook
observations.specularweight: No pilot has a SpecularWeight channel; on the authored set the PNG 8 export's SpecularWeight file has no slot and stays the receipt's consumer gap
observations.fixed_names: Item 3.5: after each of the six interruptions of a fixed-name copy (before and after the rename of each of three files), UE imports at once through the pinning adapter exactly the selected complete generation; a damaged selected generation fails before anything is staged
